name: Wireframe
description: A deliberately un-designed low-fidelity theme — black, grey and white only, no colour, no shadows, and sharp (zero-radius) corners, in a monospace stack. Every status collapses to grey so nothing reads as branded or finished. Use it to review structure and content hierarchy before any visual design, or to convert a Priority Guide into a wireframe. Apply class="a1-theme-wireframe" to <html>.
